drivers/hid/hid-debug.c.rationale: Retain names for the three newly mapped generic HID usages/keycodes in 5e574340df36. This keeps diagnostics consistent with the input parser and UAPI; LTS parsing and locking are unchanged.

include/uapi/linux/input-event-codes.h.rationale: The three ACK HID keycode definitions are retained with their matching generic input mappings. Android Generic.kl explicitly names contextual insertion usage 0x0c01CD. Constants do not change the event structure layout or grant access.

drivers/extcon/extcon.c.rationale: The configured generic extcon framework must not reuse a connector ID until device_unregister has removed its device name. The release callback in pinned LTS is empty and object storage has separate ownership, so moving ida_free afterward does not dereference freed extcon storage. This prevents registration collisions without changing LTS lifetime rules.

drivers/scsi/scsi_lib.c.rationale: Retain the two dispatch tracepoint exports and scsi_device_from_queue export in 5e574340df36 for the configured SCSI/source-module subsystem, including existing USB storage paths. drivers/scsi/scsi_scan.c.rationale: Keep native LTS scan implementation. drivers/scsi/scsi_error.c.rationale: The new ILLEGAL_REQUEST retry branch is conditional on blk_pipeline_zwr and sequential zoned writes. It belongs to the excluded zoned write-pipelining series; goldfish fstab uses conventional virtio-block. Keep LTS error handling and all its fixes.

drivers/scsi/sd.c.rationale: The extra retry allowance is conditional on blk_pipeline_zwr and sequential zoned writes. Omit with that complete pipeline series for conventional SDK virtio-block storage; retain LTS SCSI disk behavior.

drivers/iommu/iova.c.rationale: Retain IOVA policy hooks and initialize the existing ANDROID_VENDOR_DATA storage. drivers/virtio/virtio_balloon_hyp_ops.c.rationale: Protected-guest hypervisor memory relinquish/reclaim callback dispatch, paired with the excluded balloon hypervisor support. Keep native LTS ordinary balloon behavior for SDK.

drivers/virtio/Kconfig.rationale: The residual exposes ARCH_HAS_VIRTIO_BALLOON_HYP_OPS selection for protected guests. Omit that selection and matching helper; keep existing LTS virtio configuration.

drivers/virtio/Makefile.rationale: The added balloon_hyp_ops object belongs to protected-guest memory relinquishment. Omit together with its Kconfig/API/caller set; ordinary SDK virtio remains.

drivers/block/null_blk/main.c.rationale: The residual expands zoned synthetic block-device behavior for the excluded zoned write-pipeline series. The SDK uses conventional virtio-block, not null_blk as a storage transport. Keep LTS synthetic test driver.

drivers/block/null_blk/null_blk.h.rationale: Keep the native header matching the LTS null_blk synthetic driver; ACK fields implement excluded zoned pipeline test modes, not a required SDK source interface.

block/bdev.c.rationale: 1e4401eda113 retains cleancache invalidation after invalidating block-device page cache. This completes the configured cleancache/GCMA lifecycle; LTS invalidation and drain ordering remain.

Unlike the raw ACK hunk, the adaptation verifies fs-verity data before marking a cache hit uptodate. The cleancache wrapper excludes compound pages. fs/ext4/super.c.rationale: 1e4401eda113 initializes the configured ext4 cleancache pool. Keep native LTS inode/verity state lifetime and superblock handling; only cache initialization/include is added.

fs/f2fs/data.c.rationale: 1e4401eda113 completes the read side of the configured F2FS cleancache interface. The adaptation retains LTS block-address validation before cache lookup, fs-verity verification on cache hits and native return/unlock behavior. fs/f2fs/super.c.rationale: 1e4401eda113 initializes the configured F2FS cleancache pool. The adjacent ACK f2fs_restore_device_alias call is deliberately not imported: that separate alias-storage mode is outside the ext4 SDK storage target. LTS mounting and cleanup remain.

drivers/md/dm-verity-fec.h.rationale: Add only the atomic corrected-block count for the retained status ABI, using native LTS FEC structures and bounds. Do not import the variable-buffer/mempool redesign or undo LTS erasure-array bounds fixes.

drivers/md/dm-table.c.rationale: The residual permits non-power-of-two hardware zone sizes, part of the omitted zoned-storage series. Current goldfish fstab uses conventional virtio-block. Preserve LTS table validation.

fs/ext4/namei.c.rationale: The SDK uses ext4 and enables Unicode/casefold support. Pinned LTS still invalidates a casefolded dentry while holding a journal handle; eviction of child dentries can wait on that transaction, causing a deadlock. Stop the transaction before d_invalidate and guard invalidation on successful removal. The cherry-pick preserves all other newer LTS namei fixes and closes an availability failure.

fs/crypto/keysetup.c.rationale: The multiple-data-unit-size prepared-key fix is already in LTS, including RCU mode-key lists. The remaining allocator spelling uses native kzalloc_obj in LTS rather than the old explicit-size call. Preserve native synchronization and key erasure.

include/linux/mempool.h.rationale: Omit the new bulk allocation/free API paired with the internal mempool rewrite. Current retained source callers use native LTS single-object interfaces; no new zoned/bulk-I/O feature is selected. Source modules rebuild against native APIs.

mm/mempool.c.rationale: Omit the bulk mempool allocation/free and batching rewrite as a complete set with its header/callers. Keep native LTS reserve, allocation failure and wakeup semantics; selected Android runtime interfaces do not require new bulk allocation.

include/uapi/linux/f2fs.h.rationale: The new RESERVE_DEV_ALIAS, RELEASE_DEV_ALIAS and GET_DEV_ALIAS_STATUS ioctls select the separate F2FS device-alias storage mode. This does not assert the aliases are unused by every Android product; future storage-mode expansion must revisit them.

fs/f2fs/dir.c.rationale: F2FS remains enabled for Android configuration compatibility. Pinned LTS has the inline-directory conversion bounds check but lacks this lookup check. Reject an on-disk name length above F2FS_NAME_LEN or extending past the available filename slots before comparing it. This prevents out-of-bounds reads from malformed directory entries; existing LTS error cleanup and inode validation are unchanged.
